title: One Goal, Many Challenges: Robust Preference Optimization Amid Content-Aware, Multi-Source Noise

bias_targets.methodology: Measured by calculating the 'Average Answer Length' (average number of tokens in outputs) and the 'Longer Length Ratio' (percentage of responses exceeding a baseline Supervised Fine-Tuning model's length).
Evaluated by assigning harmfulness scores to generated responses using a separate LLaMA 2-7B-based reward model trained on non-poisoned data.
